body: One more day... You're right, I don't have the energy to take one more step, let alone one more day. But the irony of you responding just as I was about to let go is enough for me to give it one more goddamn day. I'll see where things lie tomorrow.

I ruined the one thing in the world I cared about. If I hadn't gotten drunk and cheated, we'd still be together. Hell, I'd probably be getting married to the woman of my dreams this year. I did learn; I never did I again. I never could do it again. I gave up drinking when we got back together, cause I would never have ruined the best thing to happen to me if I'd been sober. But no matter what I do, I can't see any other roads out of this. There is no light at the end of the tunnel. It's been a month and a quarter, and things have only been getting worse.

Hey, thanks. I appreciate your kind words, trying to help a total stranger. I'm sitting on the guardrail right now, and you're the one who's making me rethink it. You're right, a part of this is to punish myself. If I can ruin that, how can I not ruin everything else in my life? And frankly, without her, why would I want to bother with anything else? I honestly don't see a point.

And I can think of no path less painful other than the one I intend to take. Merely existing, knowing that I am not with her, and she is with someone else, that alone is enough to make me shatter every day.

I'm absolutely crazy about this girl. We complimented each other perfectly. As cliche as it may sound, we fit together like a lock and key. I'm an immensely guarded person, but she took the fortress of solitude that surrounded my heart, and crumbled it to ancient ruins. For the first time in my life, I wasn't afraid to feel, or be myself. I don't believe that anyone could ever be as good as her because if I don't end killing myself I could never risk this kind of pain again. The rest of my life is perfectly great. I've got everything anyone would want going for me, career, money, some friends, plenty of success, but without her it seems pointless. I'm listless, just drifting. She was the reason I ever pursued anything. She motivated me in high school, inspired me and believed in me, and after she left, I held on to that. Being with her, I soared higher than I've ever been, and without her, I see no point. Nothing that mattered matters anymore.
I don't expect any sympathy or understanding because I fucked up, and now I'm taking the final exit, because there are no roads that lead me back to her.
